items.text:
Absolutely great potential for a game and the creator seems to be working diligently on it. I most definitely recommend this game if you're a fan of DF style games.

If you love DF, Rimworld or any of the other top-down games in DF style, Ostranauts is most likely for you. The learning curve is steep like DF, and if you don't pay attention during the tutorial messages (like I did), you'll end up hauling every part by hand, not realising there is zones you can create to save hauling your haul of 14 doors, 2 reactors, 6 tanks one by one, all by hand, enduring a ~5 minute transition period to the blackmarket to pawn your haul per item, only to realise the guy has switched to paying under market rate for your Reactor and you have to wait another 5 minutes to hope he'll offer a reasonable price again. Took me ~25 hours of doing this before I followed the tutorial message on a new save.

Another tip: Most definitely don't decide to ransack the cops ship when they're docked to your ship. Within ~2 minutes of being on his ship (with him trying to fly away still docked), both our ships were looking more holy than a Nang Huffer's brain. The haul of 2 EVA batteries weren't worth the complete rebuild of my ship at the start of the game. Great moments of this game make it completely a steal for the price.

Since it is in early access, expect many, many crashes and bugs. Autosaving seems to be a big issue from my experience, the game runs best with it switched off. Once I've gotten about 16 hours on a save, autosaving (set to every 1 hour) takes ~45 minutes per save with a 1/3 chance of it crashing the game during saving. Especially at the OKLN station with several ships worth of loot on board. The game is definitely getting better with every update.

There was a rather annoying bug where every time my character felt an emotion (like remissness or name drop), it would stay on the ship as a blocked tile. Really bloody annoying but work-around-able. Thank you to the Devs for patching it in the last release.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏绝对有巨大的潜力，而且创作者似乎正在勤奋地开发它。如果你是DF风格游戏的粉丝，我绝对推荐这款游戏。

如果你喜欢DF、Rimworld或任何其他DF风格的俯视角游戏，Ostranauts很可能适合你。学习曲线像DF一样陡峭，如果你在教程消息期间不注意（就像我一样），你最终会手动搬运每一个部件，没有意识到你可以创建区域来省去一件一件手动搬运你那14扇门、2个反应堆、6个罐子的收获，忍受大约5分钟的过渡时间到黑市去典当你的每件收获，结果却发现那家伙已经改成以低于市场价的价格收购你的反应堆，而你必须再等5分钟，希望他会再次给出合理的价格。我这样做了大约25个小时，才在一个新存档里遵循了教程消息。

另一个提示：绝对不要决定在警察的船停靠在你船上时洗劫它。在他船上大约2分钟内（他还试图在仍然停靠的情况下飞走），我们两艘船看起来都比Nang Huffer的大脑还要圣洁。2块EVA电池的收获不值得在游戏初期对我的船进行彻底重建。这款游戏的精彩时刻让它以这个价格来说完全是白捡的。

由于它处于抢先体验阶段，预计会有很多很多崩溃和bug。根据我的经验，自动保存似乎是个大问题，关闭它游戏运行最好。一旦我在一个存档上玩了大约16个小时，自动保存（设置为每1小时一次）每次保存大约需要45分钟，并且有1/3的几率在保存期间导致游戏崩溃。尤其是在OKLN空间站，船上载着好几艘船价值的战利品时。这款游戏肯定随着每次更新都在变得更好。

有一个相当烦人的bug，每次我的角色感受到一种情绪（比如悔恨或点名），它都会留在船上成为一个被阻挡的格子。真是烦人得要命，但可以绕过。感谢开发者在最后一个版本中修补了它。
